thread:
Maria Chen: Hey team — short notice: my flight just got cancelled, I can't cover tonight's 18:00-02:00 shift. Can someone swap with me? I'm in transit and won't have reliable phone/data after 17:30.

Ajay Patel: I can take the first half (18:00-22:00) if someone can cover 22:00-02:00. Would need a brief handoff at 21:45.

Simon Lee: I can do 22:00-02:00. @Ajay Patel let's do a quick handoff ping at 21:40. Any active maintenance tonight that I should watch for?

Maria Chen: Thanks both — main notes: there's a small db migration scheduled for 20:00 that was supposed to be low-risk (PR #782), but devs reported a flakey lock in staging earlier. Watch DB connections and slow query spikes. If p95 latency > 1.2s for >5m, consider rolling back the migration (runbook link below).

Maria Chen: Runbook: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/db-migration-checklist (steps 3-6 are the important ones). Also: cache warmup job runs at 19:30 — it can spike CPU on the embedding service, so monitor emb-service GPU utilization.

Ajay Patel: Got it. I'll monitor DB and embeddings until 22:00. Quick note: if emb-service GPU goes >85% for sustained 3m, there's an auto-scale policy but it can take ~4-6 mins to provision; consider throttling large batch jobs via the dev team if that happens.

Simon Lee: Good call. What's the rollback command for the migration? Just to paste into the thread for quick access.

Maria Chen: Rollback command (from runbook):
```bash
./infra/migrate rollback --version 20260317_02
```
Also the migration job writes a `migration.lock` in S3 at s3://redwood-migrations/locks/ — delete only after confirming no active workers.

Nina Gomez: heads-up from SRE: there's a planned infra patch windows at 23:30 for a small kernel update on one of the logging nodes in us-west-2. It's scoped, but logging node restart can temporarily raise log ingestion latency; that might affect alerting for a few minutes. Keep that in mind around 23:20-00:00.

Ajay Patel: Thanks @Nina Gomez — I'll silence the noisy alert (ingest latency) around 23:15-23:50 and add a note to the incident channel if we see anything else.

Simon Lee: I'll take over at 22:00. Plan: check the DB migration at 20:10 and 20:40, monitor p95 + error rates; if rollback needed I'll coordinate with Ajay for safe time to run. Also will watch for the logging node restarts and un-silence alerts after 23:50.

Maria Chen: Perfect. I added a short handoff checklist in the oncall doc: https://intranet/redwood/oncall/handbook#handoff — second item is 'confirm backups' (we ran a snapshot at 17:00).

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: cache-warmup started at 19:30 (task id cw-1789).

Ajay Patel: saw deploy-bot — I'll watch cw-1789 CPU usage. If it goes bad I'll pause new batch jobs (ping @ml-platform).

Simon Lee: Thanks all — @Maria Chen safe travel. I'll post a short summary in the channel at 22:05 when I'm fully up to speed.

Maria Chen: Thank you team, really appreciate the quick swaps. I'll update my calendar and mark the shift swapped. :pray:
